sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '2000-12-02' AND '2001-12-01'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a','b','c')
